correctness.rationale: Exact resolvent identities and shifts yield (t-s)B R(SB-BS)R. Its coefficients equal the analytic weighted Toeplitz model (t-s)D_3 phi(S) plus a remainder with s_n=O(n^-4), via exponential off-diagonal entry bounds and Schur factorization. A proved block-localization and finite Toeplitz spectral-distribution lemma gives n^3s_n -> |t-s| J^3. Perturbation inequalities transfer the nonzero asymptotic; injectivity, compact quasinilpotence, Schatten threshold and logarithmic trace follow analytically. Four rational finite-matrix checks and three finite spectral diagnostics pass, but are not used as infinite proofs. Boundary t=1 is excluded.

value.rationale: For a natural family of sequential discrete averages, a two-parameter commutator measures order dependence. The analytic cancellation gains two powers of singular decay beyond each C_t, and the exact nonzero coefficient gives sharp all-rank approximation error, a critical quasi-Schatten cutoff and a canonical logarithmic trace. These are finer operator-ideal facts not supplied by single-operator compactness or Hilbert-Schmidt-norm calculations; the specific two-parameter coefficient has mathematical use in stability/approximation of sequential smoothing.
